scripts.prebuild:android: pnpm run prepare:whiteboard && expo prebuild --platform android --no-install
scripts.prebuild:android:production: pnpm run prepare:whiteboard && CHALK_APP_VARIANT=production expo prebuild --platform android --no-install
scripts.prebuild:ios: pnpm run prepare:whiteboard && expo prebuild --platform ios --no-install
scripts.prebuild:ios:production: pnpm run prepare:whiteboard && CHALK_APP_VARIANT=production expo prebuild --platform ios --clean --no-install
scripts.build: pnpm run prepare:whiteboard && expo export --platform ios --output-dir dist/ios && expo export --platform android --output-dir dist/android
scripts.build:android:apk:release: pnpm run prepare:whiteboard && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:android:apk:release:production: pnpm exec tsx ./scripts/run-with-production-mobile-env.ts -- pnpm run build:android:apk:release
scripts.build:android:release: pnpm run prepare:whiteboard && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.build:android:release:production: pnpm exec tsx ./scripts/run-with-production-mobile-env.ts -- pnpm run build:android:release
